ops.name: state_get
ops.summary: Read one value out of the extension's durable state.

ops.name: state_put
ops.summary: Write one JSON value into the extension's durable state.

ops.name: state_del
ops.summary: Drop one key from the extension's durable state.

ops.name: state_keys
ops.summary: List every key the extension's durable state holds.

ops.name: log
ops.summary: Emit one engine log line at a level.

ops.name: notify
ops.summary: Show one notification on the user's channel.

ops.name: shell
ops.summary: Run one shell op — start, logs, type, wait or stop.

ops.name: jailed_shell
ops.summary: Run one shell op inside the workspace jail.
ops.refusal: vis.jailed_shell needs the Vis host's jail; nothing outside a Vis process can enforce it. Run the command with vis.shell when an unjailed process is what you meant, or run this extension under vis-agent.

ops.name: jailed_shell_session
ops.summary: Run one shell op inside a persistent jailed session.
ops.refusal: vis.jailed_shell_session needs the Vis host's jail; nothing outside a Vis process can enforce it. Run the command with vis.shell when an unjailed process is what you meant, or run this extension under vis-agent.

ops.name: request_input
ops.summary: Ask the human, and block until the answer settles or is cancelled.

ops.name: live
ops.summary: Open, patch, read or close one live view.

ops.name: reveal_secret
ops.summary: Resolve a `vis-secret:` handle to its plaintext.

ops.name: forget_secret
ops.summary: Drop the plaintext a secret handle stands for.

ops.name: declare_env
ops.summary: Resolve the environment variables the extension declared.
